items.text: Patriots ruled out RB TreVeyon Henderson for Sunday’s game in Germany against the Lions.
items.implication: NE backfield thin with Stevenson also out; opportunity for remaining RBs.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay said the team will not place Puka Nacua on IR due to roster mechanics, but the WR will still be out for a significant period of time after MCL/PCL sprains and turf toe.
items.why: Roster mechanics prevent IR placement; multi-week absence confirmed, optimistic return around W14/15.
items.implication: Rams pass game gutted with Adams also out; lean run-oriented.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for remaining Rams WRs/TEs; Kyren Williams/Corum volume up.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will have surgery later this week on broken ring finger; could return as quickly as 2-3 weeks. GB decides Saturday on IR (not guaranteed). Out vs Vikings before bye.
items.why: Broken ring finger, no grip strength; surgery this week.
items.implication: Misses W10; potential return post-bye W12 if no IR.
items.opportunity: Committee work for Johnson/Lloyd/Brooks; handcuff value.

items.text: Chiefs listed QB Patrick Mahomes as a full participant in today’s practice, putting him on track to play Sunday at Atlanta.
items.implication: On track for W10 start; KC offense intact.

items.text: Vikings were positive PROE despite bad QB play; could see pass rate spike with Kirk Cousins as Kevin O'Connell wants to throw. Jefferson value vaults to WR1.
items.why: Historical 106.8 ypg with Cousins; PROE data and O'Connell scheme.
items.implication: Jefferson back to elite WR1; MIN pass volume up.

items.text: Expecting Rams to lean more negative PROE while playing without both Puka Nacua (knee, toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring). Scenarios where Adams plays and Nacua doesn't in key weeks.
items.why: Pass-game injuries force run lean; OL No.9 helps. Adams realistic return ~Nov 25.
items.opportunity: RB snaps/carries up; stash Adams for ROS.

items.text: Jefferson managers we are so back with Cousins. Averaged 19.6 PPR ppg across 54 games with him. LOVE that.
items.why: Historical production with Cousins under center.
items.implication: Immediate WR1 upgrade; start with confidence.

items.text: Vikings acquire Cousins: Jefferson value vaults to WR1 territory with competent QB; Addison hold. Raiders Mendoza: Bowers still elite TE1 but lower floor; Jeanty biggest loser as checkdown king with Cousins.
items.why: Cousins familiarity with KOC; historical Jefferson splits; Jeanty TPRR lead with Cousins.
items.implication: MIN pass-catchers up; LV volume/efficiency down short-term.
items.opportunity: Jefferson targets spike; Jeanty receiving work down.

items.text: Jordyn Tyson's time is coming, but it's not this week. I am CLOSING IT OUT on Tyson in week 10.
items.why: Not ready for full role yet this week.

items.text: I am KEEPING IT OPEN on Jadarian Price, even with Charb back.
items.why: Role opportunity persists despite Charbs return.

items.text: When you have healthy Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins... this is what you do. Let them cook. Positive PROE.
items.why: PROE data shows pass-heavy with healthy core.

items.text: Worried about Brock Bowers with Fernando Mendoza at QB? Bowers put up monster numbers as rookie with O’Connell/Minshew/Ridder. He’ll be just fine.
items.why: Proven with multiple QBs; elite TE1 talent.
items.implication: Floor lower but still startable TE1.
items.conflict: Some analysts note floor drop with rookie QB.

items.text: Cowboys have Lamb and Pickens but still pick up Ryan Flournoy. Room for him in offense and on fantasy roster.
items.why: Proven production from WR3 spot; room in DAL offense.
items.implication: Depth piece with upside if injuries.

items.text: Need a WR off waivers? Pop Douglas still available in 54% leagues. 80% route share last two games. Pick up and fine starting in pinch vs DET.
